fact: Between May and September 2025, 4,209 new asylum-seekers were registered in Tchologo and Bounkani, bringing refugees and asylum-seekers in Côte d'Ivoire to over 80,000, while only 25% of households in Tchologo and 9% in Bounkani had access to a financial service.
title: Profilage socioéconomique des demandeurs d'asile en Côte d'Ivoire
